The '''Jedi Diplomat''', also known as the '''Jedi Mediator''', was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who had followed the teachings of the [[Jedi Consular]]s. A specialized task force of large group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the Diplomats of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] were sent into tense situations to force a compromise and end the threat of bloodshed.

==Overview==
Diplomats were skilled negotiators and wore their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] as a reminder of their strength and authority. Diplomats were widely respected as peaceful beings who sought the simplest way in deciding upon the terms of a treaty. Related to the [[Jedi Ambassador]]s, the diplomats were known to take a more direct approach; not working as an intermediary, the Diplomats were the voice of the Republic and could make legal decisions based on their own experience and not having to report back to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and ask for direction. Serving directly under the [[Council of Reconciliation/Legends|Council of Reconciliation]], the Diplomats were assigned to work with agents of the [[Republic Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Republic Diplomatic Corps]] so as to best negotiate for peace.<ref name="TJP" /> 

Jedi Diplomats were trained to focus their efforts on listening intently during negotiations, refraining from speaking until they fully understood the complexities of the situation. They believed that only by understanding a conflict from all perspectives could it be resolved with fairness and compassion. Seasoned diplomats were also accomplished scholars, possessing extensive knowledge of history, culture, economics, politics, foreign languages, and psychology.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

The status of diplomat was seen once more in the reformed [[New Jedi Order|Order]] of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] following the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Around [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], Skywalker suggested that his sister, future [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]] pursue this course of study when she decided to fully commit herself to the Order.<ref name="TJP" />
